name: dsh-ctx-refresh
description: Model context-window refresh for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a settings card (Plugins section) with manual one-click refresh plus optional auto-sync — on every sent message it checks the last sync time and, once the configured interval (default 30 min) has elapsed, re-fetches each provider's live model listing in the background and writes back every explicitly configured model's contextWindow into llm-pi-ai settings; an ambient chip under the composer shows when a sync runs and its result. / DSH Web 模型上下文同步：设置页卡片提供一键手动刷新与自动同步（发送消息时检查上次同步时间，超过可配置间隔默认半小时则后台拉取各提供商实时模型列表，把所有显式配置的模型的 contextWindow 写回 llm-pi-ai 设置），输入框下方状态条提示同步进行与结果。
